$comment: Data governance policy (Phase 28.I / B-04 / Owner decisions D-GOV-1..6).
RETENTION VALUES ARE DEPLOYMENT CONFIGURATION, NOT LEGAL RULINGS: the
owner decision mandates purpose-based, minimum-necessary, configurable
retention per data class — every value here is overridable via
INSURANCE_AGENT_RETENTION_POLICY (path to an alternative file) and no
business code reads these numbers directly (they resolve through
runtime/governance.py). Days are measured from the object's
D2 operational_trace — runtime events, execution diagnostics
deletion: hard (physical delete incl. cascade) | none (policy keeps).
legal_hold exceptions are managed at runtime (holds registry), not here.

business_content.description: Consumer business lifecycle: deletable on consumer request at any time; auto-eligible after retention_days of inactivity; artifacts follow their parent run (D-GOV-4).

operational_trace.description: Shorter than business content where feasible (D-GOV-1); carries user content in message/answer payloads, therefore deleted WITH or BEFORE its parent (D-GOV-5: no indefinite raw user content).

evaluation_data.description: Minimum necessary, purpose-bound. Production conversations NEVER auto-enter eval/golden datasets (explicit selection only); on-demand operator review projections inherit the reviewed object's lifecycle.

security_audit.description: Independently governed (D-GOV-1). Audit records store actor/object/action metadata ONLY — never message bodies or artifact content (GOV-7); deletion of business data never cascades into audit records.

system_metadata.description: Operational lifecycle (metrics/health/config); contains no user business content; out of deletion scope.

tombstone.$comment: Tombstones never contain user business content and cannot restore data.
